questions: In which country is May Revolution?
Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata

May Revolution: Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata. The result was the removal of Viceroy Baltasar Hidalgo de Cisneros and the establishment of a local government, the Primera Junta (First Junta), on 25 May.
